response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is an experienced and versatile software engineer with a strong background in web, backend, and full-stack development, but his profile does not align with this embedded security engineering role. He lacks native-level Japanese (only English, Romanian, and basic German listed), has no demonstrated Linux kernel modification experience, no C-for-UNIX embedded focus, and no evidence of work with security protocols like MACsec, 802.1X, or LAN-switch firmware. His career is centered on high-level web/mobile stacks (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than low-level embedded/networking security work.
strengths: 12+ years of diverse, senior-level software engineering experience
Demonstrated ability to learn and work across many languages and domains (C/C++ experience at National Instruments)
Strong communication and teaching skills (workshops, talks, open source leadership)
concerns: No native-level Japanese proficiency, which is an explicit hard requirement
No evidence of Linux kernel investigation/modification or embedded firmware experience
No background in required security domains (MACsec, 802.1X, captive portal, switch chip/L2-L3 networking)

key_factors.factor: No embedded/Linux kernel or network security domain experience
Strong general software engineering seniority and adaptability
